notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm just writing a quick post to say that I've made a small update to this VN to fix a handful of typos which were pointed out both in the Steam community hub and in my own Discord server. [i]Ashes[/i] should be a more polished experience now, and I hope people enjoy it!

I've also added a Mac build so even more people can experience this VN.

As always, thank you for the continued support over the years; it's very much appreciated. If you find more bugs or spelling errors in this VN do let me know, and I will try to fix things in a reasonable timeframe!

- ebi x

notes.title: Dark BL VN All Scars and Starlight has been released \o/
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I'm making this announcement to let you know that my dark boys love / boys hate visual novel, [i]All Scars and Starlight[/i], has been released!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/6cd133b875288f1a6e0349c97ad40ec2224158f5.png[/img]

[i]Scars[/i] is a grim story about a deposed king, Yuel, who is taken prisoner by the leader of a rebellion and his older cousin, Tavi. Though Yuel initially despises Tavi for overthrowing him, complicated feelings begin to develop between the pair as Tavi refuses to have Yuel executed, despite the warnings of his advisors.

Wanting to keep Yuel safe, Tavi hides Yuel away in the palace where his political enemies can’t hurt him - but the biggest threat to Yuel’s life soon proves to be Yuel himself.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/de020a27bcc39533575d283937e47639f221e0e3.png[/img]

The story has choices and multiple endings, so there’s a few different ways it can pan out. It’s quite a grim story which deals with topics like self-harm, suicide, and sexual assault, and the main pairing are cousins. The story also contains explicit sexual content, so you need to be 18+ to check it out.

You can check [i]Scars[/i] out here, if you're interested:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2827190/

[i]Scars[/i] takes place in the same universe as a couple of my other VNs, [i]All Ashes and Illusions[/i] and [i]All Idleness and Ephemera[/i]. If you want to read more about the world setting in [i]Scars[/i] you can check those out here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1673020/All_Ashes_and_Illusions/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025720/All_Idleness_and_Ephemera/

And I've written some cute alternate universe stories about Yuel and Tavi that're completely divorced from the world present in [i]Ashes[/i], [i]Idleness[/i], and [i]Scars[/i], which can be found here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146500/Unluckily_in_Love/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2513080/To_Have_and_to_Hold/

Phew. That's a lot of words about Yuel and Tavi haha ;;;
I really have written a lot of stories about them over the last couple of years, haven't I?

I feel like I've talked a lot so I'll end here. If you want some quality BL Suffering then I hope you'll give [i]Scars[/i] a try at least. I poured a lot of love into it, and it was very much a project of passion!

- ebi x

notes.title: Unluckily in Love updated \o/
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm writing a quick announcement to let you know that I've released a free update for my cute BL VN, [i]Unluckily in Love![/i]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/c511f7cfaa03b60ddd909c4ef1f356dbd10777eb.png[/img]

The update includes a bonus scenario which can be unlocked after reading the main game. In this side story, Yuel gets turned into a catboy (for some reason) and Tavi has to look after him! 💙✨

The update adds 30k words of extra text to [i]UIL[/i], 10 new CGs, and several new achievements to unlock. I hope you enjoy reading it as much as I enjoyed putting it together!

If you've downloaded the game already, you will need to redownload the adult patch, as this has also been updated. The new build will not work with the old patch.

To unlock the new content, you need to read through the main story (you might need to read the final scene again if you've already read the VN). Then, the bonus scenario will appear on the main menu!

You can find the VN here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146500

I've also discounted [i]UIL[/i] and my other two VNs about Yuel, [i]All Ashes and Illusions[/i] and [i]All Idleness and Ephemera[/i] on Steam, so now would be a good time to pick them up if you're interested!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1673020

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025720

Thank you very much for your support over the years; it's appreciated. I'll try to keep  making cute VNs that people can enjoy!

- ebi x

notes.title: BL VN All Scars and Starlight has been announced! ✨
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm writing an announcement to let you know that the Steam store page for my upcoming yaoi visual novel, [i]All Scars and Starlight[/i], is now live!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/b1a8e04fe14b3808d60b195e5cb0a8094df7c1a5.png[/img]

It's a grim little story about a deposed king being imprisoned by, and falling for, his captor (who just so happens to be his cousin). There are choices and multiple endings, plus a bunch of political drama and Suffering.

[i]Scars[/i] is an r18 VN, so there are several uncensored sex scenes. The story also deals with discomforting topics like suicide and sexual assault, though all of the sex scenes depicted in this story are consensual.

You can check the VN out here, and maybe drop it a wishlist if you're interested!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2827190

[i]Scars[/i] is a spin-off of my dark BxG VN, [i]All Ashes and Illusions[/i], which features the same characters but ends rather differently. You can read [i]Scars[/i] without reading [i]Ashes[/i], but reading [i]Ashes[/i] will probably make [i]Scars[/i] a better experience.

You can take a look at [i]Ashes[/i] here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1673020

The characters from [i]Scars[/i], Yuel and Tavi, also appear in a few of my other BL VNs, [i]All Idleness and Ephemera[/i], [i]Unluckily in Love[/i], and [i]To Have and to Hold[/i]. I'm pretty fond of writing about Yuel and Tavi (as if that was not immediately obvious lmao), so if you want to read about them in other, slightly happier scenarios, you have a lot of options! [i]To Have and to Hold[/i] is also free, if that's of any interest.

I hope you look forward to the story! I'm hoping to release it in 3 or 4 months! 🙏

- ebi x

notes.title: All Ashes and Illusions released on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm writing an announcement to let you know that my newest VN, [i]All Ashes and Illusions[/i], has been released on Steam!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024327/190eeea69ee5b3911ea251da9cc0f7b4e523e3cc.png[/img]

[i]Ashes[/i] is a fairly grim 'romance' story about a delusional young prince who falls obsessively in love with his childhood nursemaid, Safiya.

[i]Ashes[/i] features content some people might find discomforting, such as: a relationship with a 20 year age difference (Yuel, the protagonist and delusional young prince, is 20, while Safiya, his nursemaid and love interest, is 41), dub/noncon, written depictions of violence, coarse language, and a lot of casual misogyny.

[i]Ashes[/i] is quite a painful read, but it's one of my favourite stories I've written to date, and I'm very fond of the characters. Do consider checking it out, if you're after a VN with an older love interest, and you don't mind a hefty dose of Despair and Suffering! I'd be very interested to hear what people make of this story (and Yuel, in particular), and whether it succeeds in ousting [i]Sweetest Monster[/i] from its position of 'The Most Unpleasant ebi Story to Date'!

If you enjoyed some of my grimmer stories that tackle unsettling subject matter, such as the aforementioned [i]Sweetest Monster[/i], [i]The Mermaid of Zennor[/i], or [i]Six Days of Snow[/i], it might be worth checking out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1673020

- ebi x
